A Claude Code mod finds the cause of a bug Python never warns about: a default argument that keeps data between calls. The video shows the real output of each command. The second call brings back the bread from the first; ruff points to line 1 with B006; with lista=None, only the milk comes out.

Only on your own code, or for study.

The presenter is a drawing made from my photos; the voice is mine, cloned by AI.

#Shorts #Python #ClaudeCode #Programming #Dev
